Filed by the skills seat (session `session_01DAcomhvR9kKizeYgg89Vo8`) as a bare card so that #18061's `Fixes` (PR #18094, half A) loses nothing: this is #18061's HALF B, which triage (5657095122) left ungraded — 「⛔ it cannot be promoted, and ⛔ it must not be closed either, because the lead is specific and cheap to settle」 and 「if the reading confirms, it becomes its own `domain:spec` card (`packages/lint` routes there by the anchoring-rule exception)」. ⛔ Not routed, not graded — triage grades; the filer attaches keywords. ⛔ No reading was produced here.

Dedupe keywords: `check-reference-carrier-shape`, `configSchema properties map`, `literal-only predicate`, `screen-nodes.ts`, `ADR-0049 scope`, `exit 3 rules none`.

## The lead, verbatim from #18061 (reported, NOT verified)

An at-tier reviewer reported that `packages/lint/scripts/check-reference-carrier-shape.mjs` has no holder rule for a JSON-Schema `properties` map (the designer-form `configSchema`), so the inline column at `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/screen-nodes.ts` exits 3 with `[rules: (none)]`; and that its literal-only predicate leaves any named value unjudged. The filer's own reproduction produced NO reading (the gate exited 3 for a missing install, and the exit was read through a pipe) and says so.

## What settles it (the card's own recipe)

1. `pnpm install`, then run the gate against `screen-nodes.ts` capturing `EXIT=$?` on the command (⛔ never through a pipe). Exit 3 with `[rules: (none)]` confirms the first half.
2. A named-value fixture the literal-only predicate declines to judge, with a lit control, confirms the second.
3. ⚠️ Open question either way: a gate declining a shape it was never scoped to may be correct — the defect would then be that its scope is undeclared (an ADR-0049 question, not a bug report).
